notes.title: Bots have arrived!
notes.content:
If your friends disagree with demonic possessions, you can populate the arenas with ghostly opponents, controlled by the magic of artificial intelligence!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42748441/1f7bfa7ed188892032b62cbf0b23a0668b9c485a.jpg[/img]

Avoid letting the bots harvest all the available souls, difficulty selector will help with that, train and improve your skills. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42748441/debbe9746a27f2d53ebf0cf5a350c0b933a3bf69.jpg[/img]

This new update will improve drastically the performance, now you’ll have way more FPS with the same PC configuration. Yes! You heard right, now the game is completely playable with almost any PC configuration, Including the latest AMD FSR 2.2 technology integration to make the experience way better.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42748441/1f7bfa7ed188892032b62cbf0b23a0668b9c485a.jpg[/img]

Remember the previous annoying bugs that stopped you to perform more kills? Well, many of them remain still there, but we have solved the most annoying ones!

We are getting closer and closer to being a decent game, have fun and thanks for playing.

[h1]Patch Notes[/h1]

[h2]Game Features[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added AI controlled Ghosts that will fill any empty player slots at the start of a match.
[*] Added an AI difficulty selector for the Ghosts to the main lobby
[*] Tweaked the Sniper’s ranged attack
[*] Added visual and audio feedback to the map selectors on the main lobby
[*] Added Spanish localization
[*] Added a settings menu to adjust the graphic quality of the game
[*] Added a UI to announce the start of a match
[*] Added a new in game cursor
[*] Added sound feedback to the main menu
[/list]

[h2]Game Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed game losing focus under various circumstances
[*] Fixed visual and gameplay bugs when a Ghost was damaged or killed
[/list]
